title: Sphere eversion reparametrization-after
pending_reason: For the selected own-version average clause, the root asserts precisely that the reparametrized loop has average g(x). Its concrete witness is an equivariant real equivalence, hence descends to a circle equivalence. Existing smoothness and zero lemmas for the same witness are separate supporting declarations; a checked bridge derives the combined existence bundle. This is a scoped average-clause control, not a claim that the single root alone expresses the full lemma.
